cases.query: What was the root cause and resolution of incident INC-NS-0001?
expected_answer_facts: Incident INC-NS-0001 corresponds to event EVT-NS-0001: 'Checkout timeout outage'.
Severity level was CRITICAL.
Root cause was: Connection pool exhaustion in checkout-service caused by misconfigured maximum connections parameter (set to 10 instead of 100) deployed in v2.4.1.
Final resolution was: Connection pool max_connections increased from 10 to 100 and connection timeout reduced to 30s; pool saturation monitoring alert added at 80% threshold.
